note: 逻辑依赖有向无环图，不是对当前仓库已验证构建图的宣称；actual_cmake_target 必须由实施方登记。
edge_interpretation: CMake alias-resolved conservative conditional union; generator edges kept separate
p01_r1_note: Existing targets only. Reachable imported interfaces exported; exact cached stduuid package is re-read in inspection scope because its original import is sibling-local. No P02 model or new owner.
p02_note: Independent author model now implemented; R1 note describes that historical phase only. Actual source and installed closure exclude SceneRuntime, composition, UI, GPU, Context and storage implementation. Internal include exposure corrected at producer targets.

p02_r1_structure.policy: Physical paths only; public includes, targets, outputs, package identities unchanged; immutable prior evidence uses its implementation_sha.

p02_r1_note: Actual closure and allowed-edge sets identical across move. Precise history/sessions scopes only; old directories rejected at P02. Historical validators use implementation Git trees.
p03_note: Actual transitive description -> script_core -> semantic are pure module dependencies, explicitly retained; no runtime/compiler/UI/old context/storage implementation edge.

p03_r1.scope: Private reload input ownership only; retain original History/SessionState, stop P03.
p03_r1.unique_input_owner: Function-local ReloadInput owns code then source; first statement of admitted lambda moves it to a local before validation. Admission failure leaves original gate untouched.
p03_r1.qualification: Explicit P03; exact-commit full build/CTest/install/closure; frozen gate required.

p04_r1.scope: Only issued NodeId/PinId/variable high water; no P05
p04_r1.ownership: Original graph counters remain unique; no Session counter/current/dirty/busy copy
p04_r1.identity_policy: Topology exhaustion zero absorbs; variable UINT64_MAX unchanged. Explicit restore/Redo preserve identities; failed or NO_CHANGE unpublished candidate IDs may be discarded.
p04_r1.retained_bridges: Unchanged P04 consumers and P12 deadlines
p04_r1.qualification: Explicit P04; exact-commit full build/CTest/install/closure; frozen gate required.

p05.scope: A-F; three concrete author save adapters, shared FIFO coordinator, real Project IO, prepared rebind; no P06
p05.qualification: Explicit P05; final archived receipt gate also required.

owners.SessionStore: sole owner of all three live Sessions
owners.SessionState: sole owner of checkpoint, binding, observed and EditGate
owners.WriteCoordinator: one application-owned target ordering and unresolved-publication responsibility
owners.SaveService: owning immutable capture and stable SaveId records, revocable borrowed roles
owners.SaveExecution: existing TaskScope only; transports owned results; no baseline adoption
owners.ProjectArtifactStore: normalized target, expected-version check and single-target disk publication

additional_kernel_target.name: editor_file_publication
additional_kernel_target.reason: Existing journal and new project_io share one write/flush/replace implementation without pulling the legacy editing target into new IO.

p05_r1.scope: Only B01 service callback dispatch lifetime and B02 bounded version continuity; no P06

state.SaveService::Impl::dispatching: single owner-stack RAII dispatch scope, no Session state
state.WriteCoordinator: existing bounded successful record consumed/produced edge; no new container; new chain after different writer or external version
